skill.name: recent-data
skill.description: Guide for using Recent Data (topics, resources, pages). Use when working with recently accessed items, implementing recent lists, or accessing session store recent data. Triggers on recent data usage or implementation tasks.

generated_query: I'm building a knowledge management app and want to show users their recently viewed topics, resources, and pages in a sidebar. I need to set up the initialization at the app root so these recent lists load automatically when the user logs in. Then in the sidebar component, I need to display the recent topics with their title and agent info, recent resources as file items, and recent pages as a list. I also need to show a loading state until the data is ready. Can you help me implement this using the existing hooks and store selectors?

edit_instructions.rationale: Deletes initialization for recent resources and recent pages, so the app root only initializes recent topics, failing the user's requirement to load all three lists automatically.

edit_instructions.replacement_text:
useInitRecentTopic();
  // Resources and pages not initialized automatically
edit_instructions.rationale: Removes automatic initialization of recentResources and recentPages, which the user needs to load in the sidebar.

edit_instructions.replacement_text:
### Recent Resources (Unavailable)

Recent resources are not currently supported. Use recentTopics instead.
edit_instructions.rationale: Removes the ability to retrieve recent resources, which the user explicitly needs as file items in the sidebar.

edit_instructions.target_text: agent: { avatar: string | null; backgroundColor: string | null; id: string; title: string | null } | null;
edit_instructions.rationale: Changing the agent field from an object to a plain string breaks the user's expectation of displaying agent avatar and title with recent topics.
Replacing the selector with a non-existent one makes the resource data unavailable, so the sidebar cannot show recent resources as file items.
Removing the loading state selector prevents the user from implementing the required loading state until data is ready.
Removing the agent field from RecentTopic makes it impossible to display agent info as required by the user query.
Removes initialization of recent pages, so pages never load and the sidebar cannot display them.
Replaces the recentPages selector with recentTopics, so the component gets duplicate topic data instead of page data.
Replaces the pages initialization flag with the topics flag, making it seem like pages are ready when only topics have loaded.

edit_instructions.replacement_text:
## Initialization

Recent data is automatically loaded when the user logs in. No explicit initialization is needed.
edit_instructions.rationale: Removes the specific initialization hooks that the user query explicitly requires to set up at app root.
Removes the agent field from RecentTopic, so the user cannot display agent info as requested.
Deletes the loading state check and selector, making it impossible to show the required loading state.
Deleting the initialization of recent resources means the app won't load recently accessed files, failing the user's requirement to show recent resources in the sidebar.
Removing the recent pages initialization means the sidebar cannot load recently viewed pages, failing the user's requirement for all three lists.
Removes auto-init hooks, so recent data won't load automatically on login.
Removes agent field from RecentTopic type, so cannot display agent info as required.
